title: The Fruit Of The Spirit 554 /
firstLine: arr. by R. J. Stevens and Margie Garrett

lines: arr. by R. J. Stevens and Margie Garrett
Scripture; Galatians 5:22
Key; Eb Starting Note: Eb
We are the branches, the Lord is the vine;
We cannot stand alone.
Abide in His words and the strength we will find,
Glory to God is shown.
Follow the Spirit, the blessings will come,
Love, peace and righteousness.
True joy can be found if you're willing to shun
Works of the sinful flesh.
Satan is warring to pull us all down,
Wages of death to pay.
But follow the Spirit and you will have found
Life on Salvation's Day.
The fruit of the Spirit brings joy to my soul.
The fruit of the Spirit how we kay know
rist is within us
He's showing the way
Eternal life He will give us,
We'll harvest the fruit on that day.
